classification.difficultyReason: Identify corresponding sides in separate, nested and crossed similar triangles, including composite base lengths.

content.prompt: Find the values of the pronumerals in each part.

spec.description: Paired upright isosceles triangles; single ticks on ABC, double ticks on XYZ and matching apex angle marks. Ordinary source blue becomes black.
spec.mathematics: AB=AC, XY=XZ, angle A=angle X; AC=6 cm, BC=4 cm, YZ=6 cm, XZ=b cm.
spec.answerVisibility: All givens visible; no calculated values.

answer.worked:
The equal sides make both triangles isosceles. Their equal apex angles give equal corresponding base angles, so $\triangle ABC\sim\triangle XYZ$ (AAA).
$$\begin{align*}\frac{XZ}{AC}&=\frac{YZ}{BC}\\\frac{b}{6}&=\frac{6}{4}\\b&=6\times\frac{6}{4}\\b&=9.\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Nested right triangles with two distinct base dimension arrows.
spec.mathematics: Whole base 10 cm, whole height 5 cm, inner height 3 cm, left base interval x cm.
spec.answerVisibility: Unknown x remains visible without its answer.

answer.worked:
The nested triangles are similar (AAA): each has a right angle and they share the left-hand angle. Matching sides give
$$\begin{align*}\frac{x}{10}&=\frac{3}{5}\\x&=10\times\frac{3}{5}\\x&=6.\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Nested right triangles; dimension arrows identify adjacent 4 cm and 2 cm base intervals.
spec.mathematics: Inner height 1.5 cm, whole height y cm, whole base 4+2 cm.

answer.worked:
The nested triangles are similar (AAA): they share the left-hand angle and both have a right angle. The whole base is $4+2=6$ cm.
$$\begin{align*}\frac{y}{1.5}&=\frac{6}{4}\\y&=1.5\times\frac{6}{4}\\y&=2.25.\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Nested right triangles with separate 5 cm and x cm base intervals.
spec.mathematics: Inner height 3 cm, whole height 5 cm, whole base 5+x cm.

answer.worked:
The nested triangles are similar (AAA): they share the left-hand angle and both have a right angle. Matching sides give
$$\begin{align*}\frac{5+x}{5}&=\frac{5}{3}\\5+x&=\frac{25}{3}\\x&=\frac{25}{3}-5\\x&=\frac{10}{3}.\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Crossed triangles with parallel top and bottom bases. Each diagonal section retains its own measurement.
spec.mathematics: Top base b cm, bottom base 4 cm; descending diagonal sections a cm and 3 cm; ascending diagonal sections 2 cm and 3 cm.

answer.worked:
The upper and lower triangles are similar (AAA): the angles at the crossing are vertically opposite, and alternate angles are equal because the bases are parallel. The upper-to-lower side ratio is $3:2$.
$$\begin{align*}\frac{a}{3}&=\frac{3}{2}\\a&=3\times\frac{3}{2}\\a&=\frac{9}{2}.\end{align*}$$
$$\begin{align*}\frac{b}{4}&=\frac{3}{2}\\b&=4\times\frac{3}{2}\\b&=6.\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Descending nested right triangles with separate 4 cm and x cm base intervals.
spec.mathematics: Whole left height 7 cm, inner height 2 cm, whole base 4+x cm, right smaller base x cm.

answer.worked:
The nested triangles are similar (AAA): both have a right angle and share the right-hand angle. Matching sides give
$$\begin{align*}\frac{x}{4+x}&=\frac{2}{7}\\7x&=2(4+x)\\7x&=8+2x\\5x&=8\\x&=\frac{8}{5}.\end{align*}$$
